_comment: Phase 8 livestock catalog. Normal animals are valuable and require care; mutant animals are cheaper and produce hardy lower-value goods. Housing and yield are data so Silas's shop and the daily tick share one source of truth.

normal_cow.name: Cleanline Cow
normal_cow.description: Rare pre-war stock. A gentle cow with premium milk and a very particular bedtime.

mutant_goat.name: Radiated Goat
mutant_goat.description: A hardy glow-goat. It forgives missed care and judges everyone equally.

normal_chicken.name: Cleanline Chicken
normal_chicken.description: Valuable clean-line poultry. Treat it well and it pays you back in breakfast.

mutant_chicken.name: Two-Headed Chicken
mutant_chicken.description: Two heads, one coop, no agreement on who ate the feed.
